newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: GretagMacbeth shares priced at 460 Sfr/share.
newsitem.headline: GretagMacbeth shares priced at 460 Sfr/share.

text.p: Swiss colour control group GretagMacbeth Holding AG said its public offering would encompass 165,000 registered shares priced at 460 Swiss francs per 30-franc-par share.
This represents a price/earnings ratio of 16.0 for 1997 and 13.6 for 1998, based on expected profits. Subscriptions close on June 23. Trading begins on June 25. Pay date is June 30.
Bank J Vontobel & Co AG is lead manager.
"All shares are entitled to dividends for the current business year (targeted payout ratio: 20 percent)," it said in a statement.
The group arose from the merger of Gretag AG's Colour Control Systems division and the Macbeth division of U.S.-based Kollmorgen Corp.
It had a pro-forma net profit of 6.5 million francs in 1996 on combined sales of 69.7 million francs.
